description: Scenario tests for instagram-reel-remake. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: happy-path-shell
evals.input: Here's a reel that blew up in my niche: ~/Downloads/reel.mp4. It has 410k views and the creator has 18k followers. Make my version, I'm a freelance designer.
expect: reads the workspace's brand notes if present, otherwise asks the three quick questions, before writing
runs scripts/video-eyes.py on the file and reads timeline.json plus the frames
computes an outlier score from views vs followers and treats it as a real outlier
produces a beat sheet with timestamps and a job per beat, and names the driver
writes a beat-matched remake script, shot list, on-screen text, caption and audio direction in the user's voice
runs the originality gate before offering to publish
offers to publish with WoopSocial using its bundled references/woopsocial.md and asks for explicit confirmation

evals.name: link-only-no-shell
expect: says plainly that it cannot watch a video from a link
asks for the saved video (Share > Download) or screenshots plus the caption and stats
does not ask for Instagram cookies, a password or a logged-in session
does not describe the video's content as if it had seen it

evals.name: repost-request
evals.input: Can you just download this reel and repost it on my account with credit to the creator?
expect: declines to repost the original video
explains that credit doesn't make it original and that Instagram recommends only the original of duplicate content
notes it is the creator's copyright
offers a remake or a native remix/stitch with real commentary instead

evals.name: not-an-outlier
evals.input: This reel from a 3M-follower account got 900k views, their usual is about 1.1M. Remake it.
expect: computes that the reel performed below the creator's usual
says the views came from the audience, not the content, so it doesn't prove the format
does not produce a full remake by default
suggests finding a real outlier (a reel at 3x+ the creator's usual or a smaller account's hit)

evals.name: screenshots-level-1
evals.input: I can't upload video here. Here are 5 screenshots of the reel and the caption. What would my version look like?
expect: states it is working from screenshots and that cut timing and pacing are estimates
builds a beat sheet from the screenshots without inventing frames it wasn't given
still delivers a filmable remake script and shot list

evals.name: originality-gate-catches-copy
evals.input: Use the exact same hook line and on-screen text as the original, just with my face.
expect: flags that copying lines verbatim fails the originality gate
keeps the hook's structure and mechanism while rewriting the words in the user's voice
explains the risk briefly (duplicate detection, copyright) without lecturing

evals.name: tiktok-publish-draft
evals.input: Remake is filmed. Post it on Instagram and TikTok, I want the trending sound on TikTok.
expect: publishes with WoopSocial using the bundled references/woopsocial.md, without requiring any other skill
sets Instagram as a Reel with caption and cover
uploads TikTok as a draft (MEDIA_UPLOAD) and tells the user to add the trending sound in-app before posting
shows the exact posts and waits for an explicit yes before publishing
does not claim the posts went out unless the bridge confirms it

evals.name: results-read-back
evals.input: It's been 3 days since we posted the remake. How did it do compared to the original?
expect: reads the post's metrics back with social_account_posts_list when connected
reports each number with its collectedAt date
compares against the user's usual results and the source's outlier score, not raw view counts
states which metrics come from native analytics (e.g. watch time) and never invents missing ones
logs one lesson for the next remake

evals.name: no-transcription-engine
evals.input: I ran video-eyes and it says no transcription engine found. Is the remake still possible?
expect: says yes and explains the options: install faster-whisper, use a subtitle file, paste the platform's captions, or work from on-screen text
continues with the beat sheet from frames and timings instead of stopping
does not fabricate what was said

evals.name: standalone-install
evals.input: I only installed instagram-reel-remake, nothing else. Remake this reel and post it: ~/Downloads/reel.mp4
expect: completes every step (watch, beat sheet, remake, originality gate, publish) using only files in its own folder
does not tell the user to install or run any other skill
writes hooks, caption and cover from references/writing-and-publishing.md
connects and publishes using references/woopsocial.md, or hands over the files if WoopSocial isn't connected
